parameters.jsCode: const body=$json.body??$json;const id=String(body.onboarding_id??'');if(!/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i.test(id))throw new Error('Valid onboarding_id is required');return[{json:{onboarding_id:id}}];

parameters.query: SELECT o.id AS onboarding_id,c.display_name AS client_name,c.primary_contact_name,c.primary_contact_email,it.token,d.name AS engagement FROM app.onboardings o JOIN app.clients c ON c.id=o.client_id JOIN app.deals d ON d.id=o.deal_id JOIN app.intake_tokens it ON it.onboarding_id=o.id AND it.expires_at>now() WHERE o.id=$1::uuid AND o.status='AWAITING_CLIENT' AND it.submitted_at IS NULL;

if(!$json.onboarding_id)throw new Error('Onboarding has no active intake request');const link=`http://localhost:3000/intake/${$json.token}`;const subject=`Your onboarding questionnaire — ${$json.client_name}`;const encodedSubject=`=?UTF-8?B?${Buffer.from(subject,'utf8').toString('base64')}?=`;const html=`

CLIENT ONBOARDING OS

Let’s prepare your kickoff.

Hello ${$json.primary_contact_name},

Your delivery workspace is ready. Please complete the secure onboarding questionnaire so the team can prepare your kickoff.

Complete onboarding questionnaire

Do not submit passwords or secret keys. The link expires after 14 days.

`;const mime=[`To: ${$json.primary_contact_email}`,`Subject: ${encodedSubject}`,'MIME-Version: 1.0','Content-Type: text/html; charset=UTF-8','',html].join('\r\n');const raw=Buffer.from(mime).toString('base64').replace(/\+/g,'-').replace(/\//g,'_').replace(/=+$/,'');return[{json:{...$json,link,raw}}];

parameters.query: WITH delivery AS (INSERT INTO app.email_deliveries(onboarding_id,purpose,recipient,provider_message_id,status,sent_at) VALUES($1::uuid,'intake_invitation',$2,$3,'sent',now()) RETURNING provider_message_id,sent_at),audit AS (INSERT INTO app.audit_events(onboarding_id,event_type,title,detail,actor_type,actor_name,metadata) VALUES($1::uuid,'intake.invitation_sent','Client intake invitation sent','The secure onboarding questionnaire was sent through Gmail.','integration','Gmail',jsonb_build_object('provider_message_id',$3,'recipient',$2)) RETURNING 1) SELECT provider_message_id,sent_at FROM delivery;
